title: Demystifying Artificial Neural Networks: Architecture, Function, and Training
learning_objectives: Understand the biological inspiration and basic building blocks of artificial neural networks.
Explain how data flows through input, hidden, and output layers to make predictions.
Comprehend the role of activation functions, loss functions, and optimization in training a network.
sections: Introduction to Neural Networks and Biological Inspiration
Anatomy of a Neural Network: Nodes, Weights, and Biases
Introducing Non-linearity: The Role of Activation Functions
Measuring Error: Loss Functions and Cost
Improving the Model: Backpropagation and Gradient Descent
Conclusion and Summary of the Learning Journey
